acceptance_criteria.requirement: all evidence commands run against one named clean repository revision and tree
the 182-byte preimage, 214-byte transport, five golden digests, and transport SHA-256 match the reviewed constants exactly
semantic, layout, executor, and relation mutation/sensitivity tests demonstrate that every child participates in the combined identity and malformed transport rejects
the proof authority seals identity before backend work, reconstructs it at receipt creation, and rejects drift or a noncanonical receipt
the complete frontend suite passes in ReleaseFast and ReleaseSafe with identical 762-pass, one-skip outcomes
the CPU product command passes, its honest proof verifies, and its receipt returns combined digest 594c88bfe11d6c8cb65918a7bfcf72257a79b61674997dbed24151ea3fb88a65
the Metal product command passes with authenticated resident execution, its honest proof verifies, and its receipt returns the same combined digest with zero CPU polynomial-composition declines
backend name, AOT identity, telemetry, and product-closure identity remain evidence metadata and do not affect the canonical program digest
package-workspace and source-conformance gates introduce no V-006 regression, and product-closure identities are recorded
the final receipt and ADR state explicitly that identity is co-attested, not transcript-bound or production-verifier-authenticated

limitations: the program identity is not mixed into the Fiat-Shamir channel, proof commitment, or public statement and is not checked by the production verifier
the identity receipt and verified proof are co-attested by the local test path; they are not one cryptographically inseparable artifact
the typed proof authority and substitution harness remain test-only and shadow-only; no production witness, constraint, prover, verifier, or transcript authority changes
the real RISC-V proof fixture exercises narrow mode only; H-005/H-006 differentials cover wide and I/O generation outside this full-proof receipt
the PCS parameters are integration-test parameters and do not establish production-security soundness
backend-neutral program equality does not authenticate the Metal build; AOT admission and telemetry remain separate evidence
this receipt makes no proving-speed, proof-size, optimized-materialization, precompile-ABI, recursion, or parallel-scheduling claim
